candidate_proposition: If wider delegation pays for agent integration with counterparties and those integrations reduce acceptance of non-agent submissions, individually useful expansion can finance a change in the outside option that makes subsequent expansion more attractive.
strongest_interpretation: When additional scope funds integrations that change counterparties’ manual-channel acceptance, more competition and perfect context portability need not preserve the no-agent option. Compare integration that complements the manual channel with integration that substitutes for it.
